comment: SoulCraft-Org/.github's Process page (Git Crafter templates/process, v7.0.2). It is also the repo's maps file. Seven library maps: the card step of triage is dropped (Projects are off), and adopt's update step reads the age of the oldest open Dependabot pull request, since the repo has no npm lockfile. Two own maps follow. Keys: Git Crafter actions/pages/action.yml; maps: pages/maps/README.md.

maps.name: Shared workflow change
maps.why: A change to a shared workflow, from pull request to the callers' next run
maps.ideal: A shared workflow changes by small pull request, scanned and reviewed first, merged in minutes; a bad change turns main red for minutes, not days.

sources.title: Google engineering practices: speed of code reviews

steps.name: Pull request
steps.rule: A shared workflow changes only through a pull request, never a direct push to the default branch.

steps.name: Secret scan
tools: Secret scan over the whole history
steps.rule: The secret scan runs on every pull request over the whole history and finishes in minutes.

steps.name: Review
steps.rule: A person reviews the head commit before merge, and a fix after review gets a new review.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: Merge the reviewed head within an hour of every check going green.

steps.name: Callers' next run
steps.rule: A caller's next run uses the change, and any red main it causes is fixed within minutes.

maps.name: Defaults reach every repo
maps.why: A default file edited here, and shown in each repo that has no copy of its own
maps.ideal: A default file is short, changed by a small pull request, merged within a day, and shown by every repo without its own.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Creating a default community health file
GitHub Docs: About community profiles for public repositories

steps.name: Edit
tools: A default file: issue form, template, policy
steps.rule: Edit one default file at a time, and keep it short enough that Claude loads nothing past a two-minute read.

steps.name: Pull request
steps.rule: Open the change as a small pull request, so the effect on every repo is reviewed in one sitting.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: Merge within a day, so repos without their own copy do not wait for the fix.

steps.name: Repos show it
steps.rule: A repo with no copy of its own shows the default, and its community profile stays complete.
